generation.scope: All adjacent-rank-six characteristic-zero lifts of any standard regular residue window are regular in all degrees. Every odd-characteristic Walsh residue with three colors per side and rank-two signed squares is such a residue. One unrestricted 76-coordinate 53-adic ball gives a Zariski-dense set of algebraic closed regular windows on the fifteen-dimensional component, even at exact period four and trivial projective stabilizer.

open_mathematics: Determine which half-period lifts fix point modules on the twenty-point locus and use evaluation to constrain normal quadratic sections. General closed-point AS membership and unrestricted component coverage are open.
